mapper.select: SELECT result.id AS simulationResultId, simulation.id AS simulationId, simulation.created_by AS createdBy, layout.id AS layoutId, simulation.layout_version_id AS layoutVersionId, layout.title AS layoutTitle, simulation.title AS title, floor_plan.name AS drawingName, floor_plan.width AS drawingWidth, floor_plan.height AS drawingHeight, simulation_option.total_people AS totalPeople, (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM layout_search_candidates WHERE prepared_simulation_id = simulation.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM proposal_simulations WHERE simulation_id = simulation.id) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END) AS isImprovement, COALESCE( (SELECT proposal_link.source_simulation_id FROM proposal_simulations proposal_link WHERE proposal_link.simulation_id = simulation.id), (SELECT search.baseline_simulation_id FROM layout_search_candidates candidate JOIN layout_searches search ON search.id = candidate.study_id WHERE candidate.prepared_simulation_id = simulation.id) ) AS sourceSimulationId FROM simulations simulation JOIN simulation_results result ON result.simulation_id = simulation.id JOIN simulation_options simulation_option ON simulation_option.simulation_id = simulation.id JOIN layout_versions layout_version ON layout_version.id = simulation.layout_version_id JOIN layouts layout ON layout.id = layout_version.layout_id JOIN floor_plans floor_plan ON floor_plan.id = layout.floor_plan_id WHERE simulation.id = #{simulationId}
SELECT metric_type AS metricType, metric_value AS metricValue FROM simulation_metrics WHERE simulation_result_id = #{simulationResultId} ORDER BY id
SELECT name, start_x AS startX, start_y AS startY, end_x AS endX, end_y AS endY, 0 AS rotation FROM walls WHERE layout_version_id = #{layoutVersionId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, name, start_x AS startX, start_y AS startY, end_x AS endX, end_y AS endY FROM layout_exits WHERE layout_version_id = #{layoutVersionId} ORDER BY id
SELECT layout_exit_id FROM simulation_exits WHERE simulation_id = #{simulationId} ORDER BY layout_exit_id
SELECT name, start_x AS startX, start_y AS startY, end_x AS endX, end_y AS endY, rotation FROM pillars WHERE layout_version_id = #{layoutVersionId} ORDER BY id
SELECT name, start_x AS startX, start_y AS startY, end_x AS endX, end_y AS endY, rotation FROM fabrics WHERE layout_version_id = #{layoutVersionId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, center_x AS centerX, center_y AS centerY, radius FROM hazard_zones WHERE simulation_id = #{simulationId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id, bottleneck_order AS bottleneckOrder, start_time_seconds AS startTimeSeconds, end_time_seconds AS endTimeSeconds, peak_density AS peakDensity, threshold_value AS thresholdValue, CAST(geometry AS CHAR) AS geometry FROM detected_bottlenecks WHERE simulation_result_id = #{simulationResultId} ORDER BY bottleneck_order

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM simulations candidate JOIN simulation_results candidate_result ON candidate_result.simulation_id = candidate.id JOIN simulation_metrics metric ON metric.simulation_result_id = candidate_result.id AND metric.metric_type = 'TOTAL_EVACUATION_TIME_SECONDS' WHERE candidate.created_by = #{createdBy} AND candidate.id != #{simulationId}

SELECT candidate.id AS simulationId, candidate_result.id AS simulationResultId, COALESCE(proposal.title, candidate.title, CONCAT('비교 시뮬레이션 #', candidate.id)) AS name, metric.metric_value AS totalEvacuationTime FROM simulations candidate JOIN simulation_results candidate_result ON candidate_result.simulation_id = candidate.id JOIN simulation_metrics metric ON metric.simulation_result_id = candidate_result.id AND metric.metric_type = 'TOTAL_EVACUATION_TIME_SECONDS' LEFT JOIN proposal_simulations proposal_simulation ON proposal_simulation.simulation_id = candidate.id LEFT JOIN improvement_proposals proposal ON proposal.id = proposal_simulation.improvement_proposal_id WHERE candidate.created_by = #{createdBy} AND candidate.id != #{simulationId} ORDER BY candidate.created_at DESC, candidate.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
